# Windows Encoded PowerShell
# id: 88affd9e-a567-4b56-af2a-c1ba04cd761d
# source: rules/windows/powershell_encoded_command.yml
# format: Elasticsearch Lucene
# Field names are the Sigma field names. No product pipeline was applied.
